summary: A 1933 L-4 ground cab in the Boise National Forest, regularly staffed until 1972 and now mothballed and kept for emergency use.

facts.design: L-4 standard cabin, 14 by 14 ft ground cab
facts.status_note: Mothballed per a climbing guide; a 2018 visit report found it needed paint and hardware work

access.note: Described as available for emergencies and as a Drive Up Emergency site; the sources describe no public visiting arrangement

visit.trail_note: A 2018 visit report describes access by ATV, UTV or high-clearance vehicle; no route details recorded here

notes_for_editor: Current condition rests on a 2018 visit report and an undated climbing guide. The Idaho Statesman item is dated January 28, 1945 and describes a summer and fall before that date, so the season year is not certain. Access is recorded as restricted (emergency use); the story does not encourage visits. No new photo URLs captured.
